name: Emberscale Greatsword procs on landed and received melee hits (#11217)
contract: Emberscale Greatsword (515223) equips proc dummy 202030 and its worldforged tiers 312531/316531/320531 (top tier item 1387216 equips 320531). Every dummy is an aura 42 trigger on the Emberscales buff with Spell.dbc ProcFlags 0, and the world had no spell_proc row, so Aura::GetProcEffectMask found no entry and the sword never procced (#11217).

The tooltips promise a chance when dealing melee damage or being struck by melee attacks (ProcChance 15). The repair grants the landed and received melee auto attack and melee damage-class ability masks for damage at the hit phase, with Chance deferred to the record.

spell_proc_chance reads the record's 15 for every dummy and aura_proc_rate replays each equipped aura's native proc decision on a synthetic event, outgoing and incoming. Before the repair the chance lookups fail with no proc entry and every rate reads 0, so the discriminating assertions fail rather than flake. A ranged auto attack is not a melee hit.
